name: Crucible ThermoSleeve Chrome Liner — Pair
description: Neoprene-analog sleeves lined with graphene heating filaments, designed to wrap chrome arm augmentations and prevent dangerous thermal transfer in sub-zero conditions. Sold in pairs, they cinch with magnetic closures directly over exposed chrome without requiring skin contact. Available in matte black or safety orange.
functionality: Maintains chrome augmentation temperature above dangerous cold thresholds; USB-C charge port on left sleeve powers heating element for up to 10 hours.
what_it_says: This person has chrome and knows how to keep it from killing them — practical, no-nonsense aug maintenance.
story_hooks: The heating element on one sleeve runs hot — dangerously hot — and someone has scratched a warning glyph into the cinch in Yoruba script.
A Circuit worker's chrome sleeve liner is the only thing keeping frostbite from setting into the nerve interface points at the wrist.
related_entities: Arcturus Defense Solutions Cryogenic Projector CP-4 'Frostbite'
